notes.v0_34_1: Decision-engine performance (043a): a post-043 query-shape correction applied after 043 and before 044. The first production release attempt (2026-10-14) showed that v_player_realized_organizational_value, v_player_expected_organizational_value, v_expected_value_research_queue and v_portfolio_candidate_readiness each inlined the whole 041 -> 042 -> 043 stack into one statement, and that PostgreSQL plans every inlined layer - including per-player layers a one-time filter skips while support is absent - so planning alone needed 70-255 MB per view and the stacked executive overview about 700 MB, which exhausted the 1 GB instance before any application deployment (the partial release was rolled back cleanly). Each view is now a thin wrapper over a staged, read-only (STABLE), invoker-rights function with a fixed search_path whose stages are separate dynamic statements, planned only when they run; gated per-player stages are not planned while their upstream support is absent. Columns, types, rows, NULLs, support states, grants, comments and security_invoker behaviour are unchanged, proven byte-identical in the unsupported, probability-only and fully-supported states (database/research/043a).

notes.v0_36_1: Product snapshot serving (045a): a post-045 serving-layer correction. The second production release attempt (2026-10-14) showed that four simultaneous anonymous reads of the staged executive overview could stall the 1 GB instance; the bundle was rolled back. The application now reads ten typed, persisted product snapshot tables (product_*), each a column-exact projection of the 042-045 analytical view it replaces plus generation metadata, rebuilt only by the explicit, validated, single-transaction disi_refresh_product_snapshots() (npm run refresh:product-snapshots); disi_product_snapshot_drift() lets the verifier prove they equal their sources. The snapshots are a derived product cache, not facts. The product contract names what the application reads; the 042-045 analytical views and staged functions are closed to anon / authenticated. Release status: schema v0.36.1, canonical through 045a (database/research/045a).
notes.v0_36_1b: Home-page status snapshot (045b): a post-v1.0.0 performance hardening. v_database_status (25 scalar subqueries over the signing, class and task view stacks) was the last public read the home page evaluated on every request and approached the statement timeout under concurrent visitors. It is now persisted as the eleventh product snapshot, product_database_status, written in the same transaction and generation as the other ten by disi_refresh_product_snapshots() (re-issued with the new stage and its validation) and proven equal to its source by disi_product_snapshot_drift(). v_database_status is unchanged and stays the internal source but is closed to anon / authenticated; the product contract swaps the view for the snapshot. No metric, datum, threshold or prediction changes (database/research/045b).
